integrity: Analytic proof; exact 2-by-2 witness; deterministic finite checker. No independent validation or publication-priority guarantee.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional real symmetric positive-definite base matrices, positive rank-one updates, and fractional exponents strictly between zero and one. Exact algebraic rank does not determine numerical rank, low-rank approximation cost, or an error bound. Earlier equivalent general operator-monotone rank criteria may exist.
title: Exact Krylov rank of fractional-power corrections under a positive rank-one matrix update
